channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Olson: GOP’s Chris Madel will need more than snark to win the governor’s race
item.description: The political newcomer’s my-way-or-the-highway approach won’t work at the State Capitol.

item.title: Park of Cottage Grove’s mental health awareness game supports student-athletes
item.description: The Wolfpack’s girls hockey program has hosted a Sophie’s Squad mental health awareness game every year since 2021.

item.title: Brion: That’s Italian? 3 Twin Cities restaurants with fresh takes on pasta.
item.description: Think you know pasta? Think again. Local chefs are rewriting the rules with international flair and craveable spins.

item.title: Scoggins: Déjà vu visits the ol’ Barn as Gophers upset Indiana in Big Ten opener
item.description: Missing three of their top players, and on a three-game losing streak, the U found something special in tripping the unbeaten Hoosiers.

item.title: Some Minneapolis City Council members want to stop Waymo driverless cars
item.description: Some council members say allowing autonomous vehicles would put thousands of mostly immigrant Uber and Lyft drivers out of work.

item.title: Meet the bakers behind the 2025 Star Tribune Holiday Cookie Contest winning cookies
item.description: This year’s winners range from a fifth-grader to Minnesota State Fair baking champions, and here’s how they created their one-of-a-kind treats.

item.title: The winning recipes for the 2025 Minnesota Star Tribune Holiday Cookie Contest
item.description: Sweet and salty, chocolate and caramel, nutty and minty — this year’s winning batch of cookies has it all.

item.title: Minnesota hosts the nation’s largest Somali population. What brought them here?
item.description: Many fled war, immigrating to the North Star State for opportunities and hospitality.

item.title: Trump’s ‘garbage’ comments threaten GOP inroads in Minnesota Somali community
item.description: Trump has ramped up attacks on Somali Minnesotans and pledged to revoke Temporary Protected Status.

item.title: The economy is dragging, but the stock market is thriving. Why?
item.description: There are seven answers in the form of tech companies like Nvidia, Apple and Microsoft. But their outsized impact could spell disaster if the AI bubble bursts.
